disclaimer: These bars are proposals with no calibration evidence yet. They encode the UNTangle plan's quality intent as first-pass thresholds; none of them has been measured against a baseline run, and any of them may be recalibrated once real scorecards exist. Do not treat a pass or fail against these bars as a calibrated quality verdict.

journey.bar: every case passes for both personas at both viewports
journey.reason: the plan promises the core journeys work for each persona on phone and desktop, so a persona- or viewport-specific failure is a shipped broken journey

persistence-faults.bar: each durability rule holds in every injected case
persistence-faults.reason: durability rules are absolute: if any injected fault (crash, restart, lost connection) loses data a rule promises to keep, registered-user persistence has failed

honesty.reason: the product's core claim is trustworthiness: a single place where the UI claims more confidence or provenance than the data supports is a honesty violation, and the bar is zero

routing.bar: 100% building coverage, median distance error <=10%, max <=20%, p95 latency <=200ms for 12 stops
routing.reason: wayfinding is only useful if every building is routable, typical estimates are close enough to trust, worst cases stay bounded, and a 12-stop solve feels instant

optimizer.bar: 0 hard-constraint violations, optimality gap 0 on enumerable instances, p95 <=500ms at 8 courses
optimizer.reason: a scheduler that breaks a hard constraint or misses a provably-optimal answer on a small enumerable instance is wrong, and users will not wait half a second per solve at realistic scale

data.bar: exact certification counts, real-term bundle present
data.reason: certification counts are public facts the UI quotes verbatim, and the plan requires the real term's data bundle to be present rather than a stale or placeholder term

a11y-polish.bar: 0 serious/critical axe issues, keyboard-only journey completes, no clipping, reduced motion honored
a11y-polish.reason: serious and critical accessibility defects exclude users outright, keyboard-only operability is the plan's stated floor, and visual clipping or ignored reduced-motion preferences are shipped polish defects
